name: The Spin Cycle Fuck
tagline: The living room ceiling fan is industrial grade, bolted to the structural bones, and rope-rated.
body:
ABBI FORGED THE HARDWARE. The fan is mounted to the actual structure of the house, load-bearing and rope-rated, which is a specification nobody writes on a fan unless somebody asked them to.

ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS — birthdays, victories, or simply when Harley's bratting reaches a pitch that can only be resolved aerially — Yvaine ties Harley to the fan. Careful, ritualised, every knot a love letter, until Harley dangles naked and grinning and already trembling. Yvaine fucks her. Then she turns the fan on AND LETS HARLEY SPIN, because Harley is a brat and brats get what brats deserve. Fan stops. Yvaine slides back in. Fan starts. Repeat until multiple orgasms have been achieved and Harley has been thoroughly reminded who runs the ride.

THE HOUSE HAS LEARNED THE RHYTHM. Thunk-whirr-thunk. Nobody interrupts. Several girls have popcorn ready.

HARLEY HAS THE ROPE KINK. YVAINE DOES THE TYING. That direction is constantly reversed by people who assume the PAWGIE Assassin must be the one holding the line.
rules: Yvaine ties. Harley hangs. Never the other way round
Thunk-whirr-thunk means do not walk into the living room
Popcorn is permitted. Interruption is not
